name: Mad Labs - 2g Disposable - Jet Fuel
description:
Bold, potent, and built to move. The Mad Labs Jet Fuel disposable delivers a full 2 grams of premium oil in a sleek, ready-to-go device — no charging setup, no cartridges, no fuss. Just draw and take off.

Jet Fuel (also known as G6) is a sativa-dominant strain famous for its pungent, high-octane character. Expect a sharp, diesel-forward aroma cut with earthy pine and a subtle sweet finish — a punchy, unmistakable flavor that lives up to the name. The effect is fast and energizing: an uplifting, heady rush that sparks focus and momentum, making it a strong pick for daytime hustle, busy afternoons, or powering through a packed to-do list.

Why you'll love it:

2G of premium oil — long-lasting and built to go the distance
Rechargeable, all-in-one design — draw-activated, pocket-friendly, zero maintenance
Signature Jet Fuel flavor — pungent diesel meets earthy pine and a hint of sweetness
Energizing sativa effects — uplifting and focused, ideal for daytime

Bold flavor, dependable performance, and effortless convenience in one compact device. Mad Labs Jet Fuel is ready whenever you are.
